description: This file implements a graceful switch load balancer for gRPC, managing the transition between different balancer states and configurations, including handling sub-connections and state updates.

classes.name: Balancer
classes.description: A utility to gracefully switch between balancers, managing current and pending balancer states, and coordinating updates and closures.

classes.name: balancerWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a balancer.Balancer to manage sub-connections and state updates, facilitating graceful switching and cleanup.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the current balancer with the pending balancer and updates the ClientConn state.

methods.name: balancerCurrentOrPending
methods.description: Checks if a given balancerWrapper is either the current or pending balancer.

methods.name: SwitchTo
methods.description: Initializes a graceful switch to a new balancer builder.

methods.name: switchTo
methods.description: Performs the switch to a new balancer builder, updating internal state.

methods.name: latestBalancer
methods.description: Returns the most recent active or pending balancer.

methods.name: UpdateClientConnState
methods.description: Forwards client connection state updates to the appropriate balancer, handling config switching if needed.

methods.name: ResolverError
methods.description: Forwards resolver errors to the latest balancer.

methods.name: ExitIdle
methods.description: Delegates the ExitIdle call to the latest balancer.

methods.name: updateSubConnState
methods.description: Forwards sub-connection state updates to the appropriate balancer.

methods.name: UpdateSubConnState
methods.description: Public method to update sub-connection state.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes all active balancers and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying balancer and all subconns created by it.
